snippet.title: Kin and Quarry Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3505770/Kin_and_Quarry/

Kin and Quarry is an incremental mining game about digging deep , collecting resources, expanding your mining kin, and purchasing upgrades all in an effort to go even deeper.
